headline: Leakers compile a playable build of canceled Portal prequel F-Stop
summary: Leakers assembled a playable version of the canceled Portal prequel F-Stop, mostly from a 12-terabyte leak that surfaced in August, with final source code and map data appearing more recently on the Valve Cut Content Discord. One outlet calls the resulting build rough and likely the closest thing to a release the game will get.
